title: dio.rank >= INFINITE_RANK could be == for clarity
description: File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py, Line 201. Rank is 16-bit (0-65535), so dio.rank >= INFINITE_RANK is equivalent to dio.rank == INFINITE_RANK. Using == would be clearer since rank cannot exceed INFINITE_RANK by definition. Minor readability issue.
